contracts.history_regimes: NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_PARAMETERS; H labels only identify the matched candidate mask
contracts.selection_policy: NOT_REGISTERED_REFERENCE_ONLY; not a global CDF or point forecast
contracts.source: Actual retained threshold identity and qualified outcome for evaluation; no evaluated outcomes enter reference probability

contracts.formula: Region counts among eligible same-position/target verified participants divided by their nonmissing eligible count; exact query line and signed official outcome
contracts.fitting: Eligible prefix frequency estimation, not estimator .fit calls; unique prefix count is reported separately
contracts.availability: kickoff+7days strictly before the actual server-source decision clock; current/revised football vintage assumption disclosed
contracts.fallback: Empty prefix uses explicitly named B0; no older-season borrowing
contracts.calibration: none; no smoothing or evaluated-outcome fitted coefficients
contracts.population_limit: Historical same-position participants may differ from offered stars/changed roles; no matched-information pure-learner claim

aliases: matched-to IDs and origin/history/output masks are evaluation views, not extra procedures
